senses.sense_definition: The quality of being worthy of honor, respect, or esteem.

examples.text: She lost her home, but she never lost her <w>dignity</w>.

target_lang_translations.it: Ha perso la casa, ma non ha mai perso la sua <w>dignità</w>.
